title: 四类微基准相对RVV的周期占比
measurement_scope: Existing frozen after rows only; no new benchmark, simulation, performance or EDA run.
sample_rule: 12 formal samples per scenario and method; before and after rows are not combined.
normalization: 100 × mean_window_cycles_VDot / mean_window_cycles_RVV, using the RVV mean of the same scenario.

rendering.axis_scale: linear, shared by all four scenario pairs
rendering.method: Matplotlib horizontal paired bars; SVG editable text; Inkscape PDF outlines; Poppler PNG at300dpi

review.numeric_source_check: Root parsed the frozen CSV and statically compared all four data rows (means, sums, dots and n=12) to render.py: exact match.
review.independent_numeric_review: Native stage2_reader_audit independently read the same frozen CSV and reproduced 83.28%,34.13%,32.60%,99.51%. Equal sample counts make mean ratio equal ratio of sums.

independent_visual_review.finding: Clear genuine bar comparison; no overlap/cropping; stream99.51% visible. Requested per-scenario denominator in wording.
independent_visual_review.resolved: Final axis title explicitly says 相对本场景 RVV 周期.

root_final_findings: Actual final PNG inspected; no clipping or overlap.
All eight bars start at zero and use a common linear percent axis.
Per-scenario normalization is explicit in the final axis title; original window cycles remain inside bars.
Unrounded bar values preserve the small stream difference; displayed label is99.51%, not100%.

suggested_caption: 四类微基准的相对周期对照
adjacent_caption_note: 取固定after记录，各场景、各方法均为12个正式样本。各场景按自身RVV平均窗口周期归一化为100%，条内保留实际平均窗口cycles，条外为VDot周期占比。single、chain、batch、stream每窗口分别包含1、256、128、64次点积；batch为四路独立任务。加速比是周期总和之比，不能把图中的周期占比标为加速比。该图不表示完整应用性能。
